arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.

arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً
translation: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while believing—We will grant them a good life.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translation: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'

arabic: وَالضُّحَىٰ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation: By the morning brightness and by the night when it covers with darkness.

arabic: وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ
translation: Enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ
translation: O you who have believed, avoid much assumption.

arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer.

arabic: وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا ۚ
translation: And be good to parents.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

arabic: وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا ۚ
translation: And do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just.

arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا ۚ
translation: Say, 'Nothing will happen to us except what Allah has decreed for us.'

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ
translation: Indeed, Allah does not wrong [even] as much as an atom’s weight.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.

arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

arabic: فَمَا أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
translation: So whatever thing you are given - it is [but] for the enjoyment of worldly life.
